name: Beta Function Splatting Kernel
definition: A 2D kernel function used for splatting that replaces the Normal distribution. It uses a Beta function to control footprint shape, offering smaller footprints and easier tuning for visual parameters like opacity and zoom.
summary: The Beta Function Splatting Kernel replaces Gaussian distributions with a Beta function to allow independent shape control and smaller footprints, enabling significantly faster volume rendering execution times.
